episodeTitle.en: Crafting a compelling product vision | Ebi Atawodi (YouTube, Netflix, Uber)
episodeTitle.zh: 《打造引人注目的产品愿景 | 埃比·阿塔沃迪（YouTube、Netflix、Uber）》

guestBioOfficial.en: Ebi Atawodi is Director of Product Management for the Creator Experience at YouTube, former Head of Product at Uber, and a former Director of Product (Payments and EMEA) at Netflix. Known for crafting a strong, unified vision, Ebi empowers her teams to achieve outsized outcomes. In today’s episode, we go deep into vision and strategy, including: • The four key elements of a good vision statement
guestBioOfficial.zh: 埃比·阿塔沃迪是YouTube创作者体验产品管理总监，曾任Uber产品主管，也是Netflix产品（支付与欧洲、中东和非洲地区）总监。以打造强有力的统一愿景而闻名，埃比助力团队取得超出预期的成果。在本期节目中，我们深入探讨愿景与战略，包括：• 优秀愿景声明的四个关键要素

title.en: Crafting a compelling product vision | Ebi Atawodi (YouTube, Netflix, Uber)
title.zh: 《打造引人注目的产品愿景 | 埃比·阿塔沃迪（YouTube、Netflix、Uber）》

summary.en: Ebi shares some of the most tactical advice Lenny has heard on developing a clear product vision and communicating it effectively to both teammates and executives. She breaks down the craft of product management and how to deliberately get better at it, plus what she's learned about building a strong product culture within a team and across a company. Her philosophy centers on leading with care—'being loved, not liked'—so that hard feedback lands in service of people's growth.
summary.zh: Ebi 分享了 Lenny 听过最具实操性的一些建议，内容是如何打造清晰的产品愿景，并有效地向同事和高管沟通。她拆解了产品管理的“手艺”以及如何有意识地精进，还谈到了在团队和公司层面建立强产品文化的心得。她的理念核心是以关怀来领导——追求“被爱，而非被喜欢”，让尖锐的反馈真正服务于人的成长。
